title: Sovereign Default Risk and CDS

maps.tested: Rated Moderately Important with the note that it largely repeats Part I, except for the final LO.
maps.specifics: The sheet's specific guidance: 'same as Level 1, but the last LO is very important on CDS.' Sovereign CDS as a measure of country default risk is therefore the one item to actually secure.

vardeezReading: CR-8: Moderate. "Overall give a good read to this chapter. Same as Level 1, but last LO is very important on CDS."

los.vardeez: Last LO is very important: CDS spreads

selectors.name: Sovereign CDS spreads versus ratings and spreads
selectors.what: Sovereign CDS spreads as a measure of country default risk, compared with credit ratings and with bond default spreads (government foreign-currency yield minus the riskless rate in that currency): timeliness, lead-lag, limits, and what the evidence supports. Includes how a sovereign CDS works (annual payment = notional x CDS spread; payout only on a credit event).

notSelected: CR-8 a to f (sources of country risk, methods of measuring it and their limits, foreign versus local currency defaults, consequences of default, sovereign rating components, shortcomings of rating agencies) carry no shape, no Map point and no Vardeez pointer; only the bond default spread comparison inside CR-8 g is covered, as part of S1.
